title: EIP-7732 Breakout Room  call #21,  August 15, 2025
summary: - PTC sample by stake but count votes individually - Commit to state root or not in the Payload Envelope (more generally: commit to the full payload envelope or not in the beacon block) - Asymmetric payment for free option problem - Enforce non-zero bids for external builders - Description of the set of changes to Proposer Boost to better handle equivocation (they are independent of ePBS)
